title: Validate collaboration values
responsibility: Define collaboration schemas and shared parsing, hashing and path checks.

inputs.name: fail.code
inputs.description: Machine-readable code that fail attaches to the thrown Error as its code property and includes in the message as Collaboration <code>. fail performs no check on it, so an empty or unrecognized string is attached unchanged.

inputs.name: parseCollaborationInput.schema
inputs.description: Zod schema object, a class instance that cannot be written as JSON, which the function runs with safeParse against the value and which determines the type T that is returned. A failed safeParse makes the function throw instead of returning.

inputs.name: parseCollaborationInput.value
inputs.description: Untrusted value of any type, passed unchanged to schema.safeParse; the function adds no checks of its own, so the schema alone decides whether the value is accepted.

inputs.name: digest.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to hash, copied into a new Uint8Array before crypto.subtle.digest receives them, so the digest covers exactly these bytes. The function makes no length check, so an empty array produces the digest of empty input.

inputs.name: digest.algorithm
inputs.description: WebCrypto algorithm name passed unchanged to crypto.subtle.digest; it defaults to SHA-256 when the argument is omitted. The function does not check the name, so an unsupported name makes the returned promise reject.

inputs.name: safePath.value
inputs.description: Repository-relative path that must not be empty, must not start with a slash, must not contain a backslash, must not have empty, dot or double-dot segments, and must not contain characters below U+0020. safePath returns it unchanged only when every rule passes, and otherwise throws an Error with code invalid-path.

outputs.name: id
outputs.description: Zod schema z.uuid() that accepts only a UUID string and returns it unchanged. It matters wherever a value must be a UUID, and any other string or value type fails validation. Accepted data examples include the UUID strings 3f9a1c0e-5b7d-4a46-8c1e-f0b9d4a7c2e5 and 0b8e6f2a-1c3d-4e5f-8a9b-7c6d5e4f3a2b.

outputs.name: sha
outputs.description: Zod regex schema for exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters, the form that anchorSchema uses for its commit field. Uppercase, shorter, longer or non-hex input fails validation, and nothing is trimmed or transformed. Accepted data examples include the 40-character commit hash 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567.

outputs.name: hash
outputs.description: Zod regex schema for exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, the length of a SHA-256 hex digest, which anchorSchema uses for imageSha256. Uppercase, other lengths or non-hex input fails validation, and nothing is transformed. Accepted data examples include the SHA-256 digest ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad.

outputs.name: label
outputs.description: Zod string schema that trims surrounding whitespace and then requires 1 to 200 characters, returning the trimmed value; actorSchema uses it for id and name, and anchorSchema uses it for state. Empty input and whitespace-only input fail validation. Accepted data examples include Release review and Mobile checkout.

outputs.name: email
outputs.description: Zod email schema that accepts addresses of at most 320 characters and returns them lowercased; actorSchema uses it for its email field. Validation runs on the original input, and the lowercase transform runs only after it passes. Accepted data examples include reviewer@example.com and maintainer@example.org.

outputs.name: actorSchema
outputs.description: Strict Zod object for a verified actor with exactly the keys id, email, name and emailVerified, where id and name are labels, email is lowercased, and emailVerified must be the literal true. Unknown keys and unverified actors fail validation. Accepted data can describe a verified reviewer with id reviewer-0142, email reviewer@example.com, name Release reviewer and emailVerified true.

outputs.name: repositorySchema
outputs.description: Strict Zod object with exactly the keys id, owner, name, private and installationId, where id and installationId are positive integers, owner allows only letters, digits and hyphens, name also allows underscores and dots, and private is a boolean. Missing keys, extra keys and wrong-typed or out-of-pattern values fail validation. Accepted data can describe the private acme-labs/sample-repository repository with positive repository and installation IDs.

outputs.name: branch
outputs.description: Zod string schema of 1 to 255 characters that rejects names with a leading or trailing slash, double-dot sequences, @{, whitespace, ~, ^, :, ?, *, [, a backslash, double slashes, a .lock path component, or a path component that starts with a dot. It is returned unchanged, so an invalid name fails instead of being repaired, and anchorSchema uses it for its branch field. Accepted data examples include main, feature/evidence-grid and release/2026.11.

outputs.name: entityId
outputs.description: Harness unit ID string that must match unitIdPattern from src/lib/contracts and be at most 240 characters. It matters wherever a value names a unit, such as the entityId field of anchorSchema, and the value is returned unchanged. Accepted data examples include reports.component.evidence-grid and collaboration.function.parse-collaboration-input.

outputs.name: anchorSchema
outputs.description: Strict Zod object whose keys branch, commit (a sha), entityId, version, imageSha256, state, viewport and region must all be present; branch, commit and entityId are never null, while version (v followed by at least three digits), imageSha256 (a hash), state (a label), viewport (desktop, tablet, mobile or diagram) and region (x and y from 0 to 1, width and height above 0 and at most 1, and x plus width and y plus height at most 1) may be null. A non-null imageSha256 requires non-null version, state and viewport, and a null imageSha256 requires state, viewport and region to be null. Accepted data can anchor a default desktop evidence-grid design at version v012, or name an entity with null image fields.

outputs.name: fail
outputs.description: Never returns: it always throws a plain Error whose message is Collaboration followed by the supplied code and whose code property is that code. It matters because callers receive no return value, only the thrown error.

outputs.name: parseCollaborationInput
outputs.description: The data from a successful schema.safeParse with the schema's transforms already applied, and this is the function's only return value. On failure the function throws an Error with code invalid-input instead, and the same function is exported under the alias parse.

outputs.name: digest
outputs.description: Resolves to the lowercase hexadecimal form of the WebCrypto digest, two characters per byte, so SHA-256 yields 64 characters. It matters when a hash is compared or stored, and the promise rejects when crypto.subtle.digest rejects.

outputs.name: safePath
outputs.description: The same string as safePath.value, returned unchanged once every check passes. The function never trims, normalizes or resolves the path, so callers receive exactly the path they supplied.

errors.name: CollaborationInputError
errors.description: The CollaborationInputError built by fail, with message Collaboration followed by the code and a code property holding that code. parseCollaborationInput throws it with invalid-input, safePath throws it with invalid-path, and fail throws it with whatever code it receives.

errors.name: DOMException
errors.description: Rejection from crypto.subtle.digest that digest does not catch, so the WebCrypto error reaches the caller unchanged, for example for an algorithm name that WebCrypto does not support.
